boundaryGate.question: Does the accepted P10 per-host runProjectIndexWorkflow(mode) refactor preserve real BiliDili behavior for both in-process Alembic and host-agent AlembicPlugin flows, including full/incremental mode routing, R-2 cleanup roots, session release, coverage/deepMining progress, host response tool stability, and normalized incremental parity?
boundaryGate.objectBoundary: Real BiliDili workspace only. Code points: Alembic aa7aeb9605f7b3f9a5a0584d1a40b06d095c1813, AlembicPlugin 95bf4578ec3e2b9d19db8c548b8bfd6a98814b8e, AlembicCore 99a7cf10d82056cd860eb0a1d9544662e3735b08 via local source/vendor pins. Test collects runtime evidence only and must not edit product code or provider configuration.
controllerSelfChecks: Controller accepted P10 code phase at state revision 63 after reviewing raw target results and source files.
Alembic validation rerun by controller: npm run build:check, npm run lint:repo-boundary, targeted Vitest 5 files / 39 tests, git diff --check HEAD~1 HEAD.
AlembicPlugin validation rerun by controller: npm run build:check, npm run lint:repo-boundary, targeted Vitest 3 files / 8 tests, Biome changed-file check, git diff --check HEAD~1 HEAD.
Controller verified old wrapper names, CLI/daemon consumers, Plugin MCP handler names, frozen strings, and R-2 plan-builder cleanup root anchors in code.
realScenarioConditions: Use the real BiliDili workspace directly; do not create a sandbox copy.
Before any destructive reset, prove the R-2 root guard/characterization so BiliDili projectRoot and Alembic dataRoot cannot be confused.
Keep configured providers unchanged: DeepSeek for generation and local Qwen/Qianwen for embeddings.
Between runs, use the authorized Alembic bootstrap rebuild/reset for the BiliDili workspace only.
Capture raw command/log/database/JSON evidence under Test-owned evidence paths.
successMeans: In-process full path: daemon/job or CLI evidence shows bootstrap mode via runProjectIndexWorkflow(mode='full'), job kind/source remain bootstrap/in-process, coverage_ledger cells become non-empty, and full-reset cleanup is under projectRoot.

In-process incremental/deepMining path: rescan/deepMining mode via runProjectIndexWorkflow(mode='incremental') advances deep_mining_rounds and writes non-empty coverage_ledger cells; DeepMiningRoundGate remains caller and terminates via advisor stopReason.
In-process session-release assertion: bootstrap workflow session is released after onBootstrapComplete; evidence can be session registry post-run empty or explicit release log.

Host-agent full path: alembic_bootstrap reaches planGate.status='ready', response.tool remains alembic_bootstrap, and cleanup/reset evidence shows host-agent destructive cleanup under dataRoot, not projectRoot.

Host-agent incremental path: alembic_rescan reaches planGate.status='ready', response.tool remains alembic_rescan, meta.coverageLedgerSeed remains present, and coverage/deepMining evidence is non-empty where applicable.

Parity: one incremental in-process run and one host-agent run over the same BiliDili module/dimension set produce normalized coverage_ledger diff == empty, with documented exclusions only for allowed volatile round-driving fields.
failureMeans: A blocked result must name the exact failing stage: root safety, provider/runtime, in-process full, in-process incremental/deepMining, session-release, host full, host incremental, parity, or evidence export.
If R-2 proof fails or root identity is ambiguous, the result is blocked and no destructive reset may run.
If providers are missing/misconfigured, classify as environment/provider blocker and include raw config/log evidence without changing configuration.
If code behavior fails after root/provider safety, classify owning repository and include raw logs, command output, DB rows, and reproduction commands.
cannotConclude: Do not conclude the whole demand is complete from P10 REAL-TEST; later P11-P15 gates remain.
Do not claim P11 moduleMining binding-rich selector behavior, P12 FileChangeHandler rename, or P13 HostAgent facade rename is validated by this test.
Do not accept code or create next dispatch from Test; return TargetResultEnvelope only.
Do not treat a single host pass as parity success.
Do not infer success from command exit alone without DB/log/output evidence.
stopConditions: Root identity or R-2 guard cannot be proven before destructive operations.
The operation would touch non-BiliDili project/data roots or unrelated real ~/.asd data.
Provider configuration differs from required DeepSeek/local Qwen setup and cannot be verified read-only.
BiliDili workspace is unavailable or dirty in a way that makes evidence unsafe.
A command would require changing product code, package versions, release state, or frozen values.
Evidence cannot be captured in reviewable files/logs/JSON.

evidenceRequired: R-2 root guard evidence before reset.
Command/log evidence for in-process full and incremental/deepMining paths.
Command/log evidence for host-agent alembic_bootstrap and alembic_rescan paths.
DB/exported JSON evidence for coverage_ledger and deep_mining_rounds before/after where relevant.
Normalized parity JSON or equivalent diff proof showing diff == empty.
Provider/config evidence showing DeepSeek generation and local Qwen/Qianwen embedding were preserved.
allowedOperations: Run Alembic/AlembicPlugin commands or MCP flows against the real BiliDili workspace.
Restart or use the local Alembic runtime only as needed for this BiliDili test.
Use authorized rebuild/reset on the BiliDili workspace after R-2 proof.
Inspect and export BiliDili Alembic DB rows/logs for coverage_ledger, deep_mining_rounds, job/source/tool/session evidence.
Create Test evidence files under Test/tmp or the state-root evidence area.
forbiddenOperations: Do not edit Alembic, AlembicPlugin, AlembicCore, BiliDili product source, provider config, package versions, release assets, or git history.
Do not push, publish, tag, bump versions, or change frozen strings.
Do not touch unrelated real ~/.asd data or any non-BiliDili workspace data.
Do not write real thread ids into tracked docs, backfill, or GitHub.
Do not perform P11 selector changes, P12 FileChangeHandler rename, or P13 HostAgent facade work.
